While views are modest, topics centered around active self-worth boundaries consistently outperform passive sadness or abstract heartbreak.

winning_patterns.action: Continue utilizing specific, highly relatable mobile interface triggers related to self-respect.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like `hT4EGP69mRw` (3 views) and `uIbMpCjVutQ` (6 views) relying purely on vague tea-drinking or ringing phone tropes performed poorly.
